scopes.notes: Which physical warehouses hold stock at cutover, and what the on-hand balance is counted against, is Taylor's to state. Verenward has not assumed a warehouse list.
Whether Taylor counts to bin granularity at all, or only to warehouse, changes the count procedure and the acceptable variance. Unanswered.
Truck stock is mobile custody: the count must be taken at a stated moment with the trucks off the road, or it cannot be reconciled. Taylor sets that moment.
Serialized assets reconcile unit by unit, not by quantity. Whether Taylor holds serials today, and where, is part of the source census and is still UNKNOWN.
